purpose: Publisher-authored declarative input recipes for choosing an appropriate scientific tool. Subordinate to current MCP schemas and source response contracts; not an executor.
evidenceStatus: Source-derived local adapter 1.6.0 input contracts, not newly observed tool results, a live catalog capture or measured agent selection.
pointerRoot: MCP CallToolResult; excludes the outer JSON-RPC envelope
beforeBinding: Check HTTP/transport and JSON-RPC errors before reading the MCP result.
Check MCP isError and the route-specific domain status before taking values; check non-null adapter_error where supplied by that route contract.
Verify completeness, selected identity and snapshot consistency. Missing pointers or identity/snapshot mismatches stop the recipe; do not substitute values.
Bindings in one responseGroup come from the same successful source-tool response and explicit selected member. Never mix responses or invent snapshot/cursor values.
Response-bound recipes are not executable arguments. Obtain real values before forming a call; no candidate is automatically selected.
globalExclusions: Patient histories, patient phenotype narratives, family/segregation or private case data.
Sequencing-file/VCF uploads, variant calling, whole-genome or batch processing.
Patient diagnosis, treatment recommendations or autonomous clinical reporting.

routes.task: Interpret one already identified public GRCh38 germline variant
inspectOutput: Check result.status before result.identity or result.interpretation; ambiguity requires an exact allele choice.
Preserve canonical identity, transcript versions, automated classification/criteria, separate ClinVar assertions, evidence availability and provenance.
routes.sourceScope: Automated variant-level evidence for one supported nuclear SNV or simple indel smaller than 50 bp. Returned reference releases may differ by source; not a complete or latest ClinVar/gnomAD claim.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
Do not substitute transcript versions, choose ambiguous alleles or turn not_found into benign evidence.

Use an appropriate upstream workflow for GRCh37, somatic interpretation, structural/mitochondrial variants, sequencing files or batch analysis. Verify the current primary source when its latest assertion is required.

routes.task: Find publications linked to a resolved public variant

bindings.selectionRule: Use only after result.status=resolved and verified identity; do not bind from an ambiguous or unavailable result.

inspectOutput: Check structuredContent.status and variant_result before reading literature.
Preserve match_type, exact_variant versus variant_alias versus gene_association, publication links, corpus provenance and limitations.
routes.sourceScope: PubMed-derived genetics corpus linked to a supported variant; a gene-associated paper is not exact-variant evidence. Literature does not change automated classification.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
A missing or unavailable literature result is not proof that no publication exists. Use a primary publication database for broader or freshest coverage.
Do not infer pathogenicity from a match or silently substitute a different allele.

routes.task: Review the bibliographic record for a selected returned publication

bindings.selectionRule: Select a returned publication after checking variant/literature outcomes; use its digit-only PMID.

inspectOutput: Preserve publication identity, source URL, date, retraction flag and available abstract/full_text_url fields.
An absent abstract or full_text_url remains unavailable; this call does not fetch publisher full text.
routes.sourceScope: One record in the current PubMed-derived genetics corpus, not a guarantee of every PMID or current publisher content. An independently verified public PMID is also accepted by the tool schema.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
On publication_not_found, report the corpus miss and consult the primary record if needed; never fabricate a record or abstract.

routes.task: Find biomedical papers using a public question or publication identifier
inspectOutput: Preserve match types, publication/source identifiers, ranking and semantic degradation flags.
Check has_more/next_cursor; continue only the same query and sort. A single page is not exhaustive.
routes.sourceScope: PubMed-derived genetics corpus; public PMID, DOI, PMCID, gene, variant, phenotype, HPO and OMIM concepts may be queried. Public concepts are distinct from patient phenotype narratives.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
Use the primary publication database when broader coverage or the latest publication state is essential.
Semantic relevance or a literature association does not establish causality, curated validity or pathogenicity.

routes.task: Retrieve curated disease assertions for an exact public gene
inspectOutput: Check status=ok/not_found; preserve each association's disease identity, classification, inheritance, report URL and date.
Preserve source snapshot/version and pagination.total/nextOffset; do not merge distinct assertions.
routes.sourceScope: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity snapshot only for this tool; no comprehensive disease catalogue or GenCC/Orphanet/Gene2Phenotype coverage claim.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
Use an exact approved symbol or HGNC ID, not an unresolved alias. Resolve aliases separately without treating the two tools as one evidence source.
A snapshot miss does not establish no association; consult ClinGen or another appropriate primary source for newer or broader assertions.

routes.task: Find curated genes for a public disease identifier or name
inspectOutput: Keep distinct disease identities from name_contains matches; use an exact returned MONDO identifier when appropriate.
Retain separate source assertions, assessments, inheritance, source dates and pagination.
routes.sourceScope: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity snapshot queried by exact MONDO or disease-name substring, not a patient diagnosis or a comprehensive disease-gene catalogue.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
Do not silently select one disease from a substring match. A no-match snapshot query is not proof of biological absence.
Use current primary disease resources when broader source coverage is required.

routes.task: Resolve a public human gene symbol, alias or stable identifier
inspectOutput: Inspect exact/alias/ambiguous/not_found/withdrawn, candidate_total, complete and every candidate's identity/status.
Retain identity_snapshot_id with the explicitly selected HGNC identity for subsequent reads.
routes.sourceScope: Public immutable human gene identity snapshot. Alias and previous-symbol matching are identity resolution, not gene-disease validity.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
For ambiguity require an explicit candidate choice; do not select a familiar gene or the first candidate.
For withdrawn/missing identities preserve the status and verify the primary nomenclature source; never silently adopt a replacement.

routes.task: Read a source-qualified profile for the selected public gene

bindings.selectionRule: Use an exact/alias single approved candidate only after verifying identity, or an explicitly chosen candidate when ambiguous; never choose the first by default.
Use the snapshot from the same successful resolution response as the selected gene; missing or unavailable snapshots require fresh resolution.

inspectOutput: Verify echoed gene_id/snapshot_id against the selected identity; preserve sources and each section's status, coverage, freshness and limitations.
Preserve native assemblies, count units, nulls and unavailable/not_integrated versus no_record states.
routes.sourceScope: Snapshot-bound projections from explicitly labelled providers. Native GRCh37 transcript evidence does not expand GRCh38 variant interpretation input scope.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
On snapshot_unavailable restart resolution and reload the profile; do not combine snapshots or silently substitute the available one.
Use each provider's primary record for a latest-source requirement. Gene evidence is not variant classification or diagnosis.

routes.task: Read or continue one source-qualified gene evidence section

bindings.selectionRule: Use an exact/alias single approved candidate only after verifying identity, or an explicitly chosen candidate when ambiguous; never choose the first by default.
Use the snapshot from the same successful resolution response as the selected gene; missing or unavailable snapshots require fresh resolution.

inspectOutput: Verify gene_id/snapshot_id/section; preserve source release, coverage, pagination and count units.
For continuation pass only the returned opaque cursor for the same gene/snapshot/section; omit it for the first page.
routes.sourceScope: One bounded section of the same immutable profile. Constraint, dosage, expression, GWAS and validity are distinct evidence types; overlapping counts must not be summed as independent support.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
Stop on invalid cursor or identity/snapshot mismatch. Re-resolve after snapshot_unavailable; never invent a cursor.
Unavailable or unintegrated evidence is not a negative finding; consult the named primary source if required.

routes.task: Find a separate live literature capture for the selected gene

bindings.selectionRule: Use an exact/alias single approved candidate only after verifying identity, or an explicitly chosen candidate when ambiguous; never choose the first by default.
Use the snapshot from the same successful resolution response as the selected gene; missing or unavailable snapshots require fresh resolution.

inspectOutput: Verify selected gene/snapshot; preserve captured_at/capture_sha256, match labels, degradation and pagination.
Continue only the returned cursor for the same gene/snapshot/sort capture. Keep this live capture distinct from the profile literature section.
routes.sourceScope: Abstract-free, query-matched live discovery through the literature service, not guaranteed exact-gene filtering, full text or curated gene-disease validity.
stopOrUseAlternative: Stop on transport/RPC/MCP errors or a non-null adapter_error where supplied by the route contract; preserve the typed outcome without invented evidence.
A query match does not establish a gene-disease assertion or variant pathogenicity; inspect linked primary publications.
On missing snapshot, invalid cursor or unavailable service retain the typed failure; no model-generated replacement evidence.
